title: Loams usage event
description: A usage event: a CloudEvent 1.0 in JSON structured mode, in the Loams usage profile (design §63 §6.1), which OpenMeter's POST /api/v1/events accepts unchanged. `data` follows the schema its `dataschema` names.

id.description: Derived from the work, stable across retries; source + id is the dedup key

source.description: loams://<cluster>/<role>/<node> for Loams' producers, loams-ns://<ns>/<client> for tenant producers

type.description: io.loams.dev.usage.<product>.<name>.v<major> for Loams' meters; tenants may not use io.loams.dev.*

subject.description: The billing subject (org_<id> for Loams' billing); the stream's partition key

time.description: RFC 3339, nanoseconds allowed: the end of the measured interval

loamslease.description: The lease that admitted the work (§63 §11.3); exporters strip it
